definitions.explanation: A complex emotional state mixing sadness with sweetness, often related to longing, nostalgia, or unrequited feelings.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のことを{思|おも}い{出|だ}すと{切|せつ}ない{気持|きも}ちになる。
examples.english: When I think of her, I feel a bittersweet ache.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}の{結末|けつまつ}は{切|せつ}なくて{泣|な}いてしまった。
examples.english: The ending of this movie was so heartrending that I cried.

examples.japanese: {切|せつ}ない{恋|こい}の{歌|うた}が{流|なが}れていた。
examples.english: A song of bittersweet love was playing.

examples.japanese: {胸|むね}が{切|せつ}なくなるほど{会|あ}いたい。
examples.english: I miss you so much it makes my heart ache.
examples.notes: 胸が切ない is a common collocation

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {切|せつ}なく
・Noun form: {切|せつ}なさ (the feeling of bittersweet longing)

{切|せつ}ない describes a nuanced emotional state that combines sadness with a bittersweet quality. It is often used for:
・Unrequited or lost love
・Nostalgic longing for the past
・Poignant moments in stories or films

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{胸|むね}が{切|せつ}ない (heartache)
・{切|せつ}ない{思|おも}い (bittersweet feelings)
・{切|せつ}ない{恋|こい} (bittersweet love)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{悲|かな}しい: Pure sadness, less nuanced
・{切|せつ}ない: Sadness mixed with longing or sweetness
・{寂|さび}しい: Loneliness, missing someone
